incident.description: An attempted header-only audit requested lines 1-2 from six raw abundance matrices, exposing the first abundance row as well as the header. Those response surfaces are therefore excluded from any prospective test.

geographic_cascade_rule.rule: exclude the entire connected component of metadata-defined study geographies whenever any directly opened study lies in that component; studies are linked when >=80% of the smaller study's island coordinates match after rounding lat/lon to 5 decimals
